notes.title: Beta Release for the 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
The Beta-Branch is live!

Keep in mind that this is a TESTING VERSION that is still IN ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT.

Crashes, Bugs and other not-so-fun problems may appear.

How do you get the Beta-Branch?

Easy:

1. Go to your library and right-click Shop-Like and select properties
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092229/4c599707f6786cfbc10ef8627e3935e09af42d0d.png

2. Go to Betas and select beta under Beta Participation
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092229/8b20244b2147a7f389130319e7f651480ddc319a.png

3. Steam should now download the beta version


Important Note:
I am not entirely sure what happens when you switch from the Beta Version back to the normal version. The Savefile could break doing so, I have to do more testing for that.


Changelog 1.1 BETA VERSION

New Features

 Overhaul of the Influence Market at the Shadow Clan
 Heroes can now be send on Adventures through the Hero Visiting Menu at the Heroes' Guild
 Whole new set of difficulties with each town having 4 different difficulties to beat


Quality of Life

 Some issues with the autosave system have been fixed
 In the pause menu you get the town and medal you are currently playing displayed


Balancing

 Upgrading the School raises XP gain by +100 instead of +50
 Item prices can never go below 0



Miscellaneous

 Added more names to the game
 Added a new headwear for heroes
 Optimised the database generation at the beginning of each run, to prevent crashes with the new medal system (still work in progress)
 The Discord Link works again

notes.title: Devlog for the upcoming 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hi Shop-Like Community!

It's been a couple of weeks and development for Shop-Like has not ceased! 

Some of the promised features are on their way and I plan to release a Beta-Branch on friday.

What will be new in the Beta Version?

Sell Influence Points
A much-requested feature was the ability to trade influence points. You will get this option by being able to sell influence points that you don't need and use that money to buy new influence points that you need. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092229/31551fd4a11a414cf65ac46d963129a0682cd795.png

Send Heroes on Adventures
So far heroes can only change their stats when they go on an adventure on Adventure Day. So far the player had relatively less influence about who will go on that adventure and therefore was a part of the game that could be safely ignored.

To make this system a bit more interesting you can send heroes now on an adventure via the visiting menu at the Heroes' Guild. This should allow the player to have way more options in shaping their customer pool and invest in the adventure day chances.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092229/cbb2de56e416c5daed3a3d3d326ab96d097ee0fc.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092229/36bd64e0360d64e45007bca80c36de893c0eade9.png

Medal System
Since a lot of players have already finished the game, I thought I give them some new content to play through. Admittedly I was surprised how quickly players found ways to exploit the systems and found ideal ways through the mechanics to beat the scenarios. So I created a medal system that effectively quadruples the content we have so far.

Basically, there are Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Diamond Medals for each city. Each medal adds some modifiers to the run to make it a lot harder. Testing the difficulty of these new medals proves to be very time-consuming, which is why I am releasing the new update as a beta version first.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092229/b5d74ae0cbb6bbf4ca55e070b85f92637031a5ae.png

Thank you guys for your patience and hopefully some of you will find your way into the beta branch!

notes.title: Patch 1.043
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Couple of minor bug fixes and exploit stoppers in this patch.


 Added names from the discord
 You can't click multiple times on the "We don't have this right now"-Button anymore
 You can't offer a negative buying price during haggling anymore
 You are not allowed to play Gamblecard if you have forgotten to enter a betting amount
 There is a version number at the bottom right in the main menu now

notes.title: Patch 1.041 - Hotfixes and Gamble Card Balancing
notes.notes:
I am reading your feedback and reacting quickly! First Patch for Shop-Like is out now!

Changelog:

- Window Mode changing to Full Screen in Main Menu Bug has been fixed
- Gamble Card Betting Limit has been reduced
- Gamble Card Rewards have been reduced from 3x/2x to 2x/1.5x
- A bug was fixed that was locking out the bank, if you would leave the run during a round of gamble card
